track.title: Gusheh-e Moshtarak 29: Chaharmezrab
track.notes: A gushe shared by several dastgah-ha (gusheh-ye moshtarak); the album does not say which dastgah it is played in here. In his radif albums Alizadeh plays Chaharmezrab in Chahargah, Homayoun, Mahur, Nava, Segah. Its tonic is its own voted finalis.

just_intervals.note: measured octave minus 1200 ¢, register to register

progression.narrative: The performance opens on C3 and dwells most on A in Chaharmezrab. The line peaks at E4 (333.4 Hz) at 0:34.3. It closes on the tonic (E4 → E4 → A2 → A2 → A2 → A2).
